abortReason.reason: Insufficient bounded time to transfer, independently inspect, sign, import, assemble, commit and reverify without rushing a production authority path.

custodyFinding.finding: The terminal identified as the owner device enumerated both the owner and reviewer private-key files.
custodyFinding.impact: Two-party signature verification would remain cryptographically valid but would not prove independent device or trust-domain custody.
custodyFinding.requiredDisposition: Generate a new reviewer key only on a separate controlled reviewer device, revoke the co-resident reviewer key, update the pinned trust registry from the new public profile, rebuild the secret-free kit and independently verify it before any new request.

nextCanonicalItem: Rotate the reviewer signing key on a genuinely separate reviewer device and import only its public profile plus explicit revocation of the co-resident reviewer key. Do not reuse this request, decision, nonce or local owner signature.
